obligations.question: Define one concrete three-or-more-phase Bombay actor protocol and justify its relevance.
Specify valid traces, phase-local messages, transitions, termination, initialization, and errors.
List the exact invalid programs that must fail to compile and why runtime rejection is insufficient.
Separate actor-model laws, session-type results, Bombay derivations, policies, and application choices using primary sources.
Test the concrete case against current Fsm and state precisely what it can and cannot guarantee.
Attempt a public-API derivation using Behavior, associated types, sums, products, typestate, and uninhabited types.
Attempt an application-local concrete behavior before proposing reusable core API.
Record exact compiler/type/composition obstruction for every failed derivation.
Provide positive and compile-fail probes for every claimed static guarantee.
Check Actions preservation and relevant wrapper orders, initialization, errors, termination, and births.
If a core construction is proposed, prove its public surface is minimal, static, and law-backed.
Actively try to falsify the preferred outcome with a competing derivation and adversarial examples.
Choose exactly one allowed outcome and explain why the other outcomes were rejected.
Write the final report with sources, derivations, experiments, limitations, and remaining risks.
Run focused checks, workspace nextest, and nix flake check on the final tree.
